purpose: select the least expensive paired-question-consensus call budget from frozen fresh-structure validation outcomes

candidate_grid.paired_seed_definition: both candidate orientations at one common sampling seed
candidate_grid.terminal_pair_failure_policy: discard the incomplete paired seed and retry both orientations at the next distinct seed
candidate_grid.scientific_disagreement_retry_policy: none; identity-normalized question consensus owns cross-orientation disagreement
candidate_grid.repetition_aggregation: arithmetic mean of complete paired-question-consensus decision values followed by the frozen tie threshold

selection_rule: retain only configurations passing every gate
minimize expected logical LLM stages per pair
then minimize maximum logical LLM stages per pair
then minimize target complete paired seeds
then minimize maximum distinct seed attempts
interpretation_boundary: unlabeled defect-tradeoff winners never contribute to accuracy or operating-point selection
